name: VWS-optimized Transfer Function Optimization
definition: An automatic optimization approach that adjusts opacity transfer function values to match a user-specified target distribution of Visibility-Weighted Saliency (VWS) values across distinct features in a volume dataset.
summary: VWS-optimized Transfer Function Optimization automatically adjusts opacity to match user-defined feature visibility, distinguishing itself by using global visibility metrics rather than local voxel contributions or histogram matching.
